gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Sung Tak Street running northward, then turning north-westward, then westward, then southward joining Oi Kwan Road for a total distance of approximately 290 m, as shown coloured pink and pink hatched black in Drawing No. HH 3608.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點與崇德街會合，向北伸展，先轉向西北方，繼而轉向西方，再向南方伸展，與愛群道會合，全長約為二百九十米，其位置在 HH 3608 號圖則內用粉紅色及粉紅底黑間綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Morrison Hill Road running westward for a distance of approximately 24 m, as shown coloured green in Drawing No. HH 3608.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點與摩利臣山道會合，向西伸展約廿四米，其位置在 HH 3608 號圖則內用綠色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Oi Kwan Road running north-eastward for a distance of approximately 36 m, as shown coloured blue in Drawing No. HH 3608.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點與愛群道會合，向東北伸展約三十六米，其位置在 HH 3608 號圖則內用藍色標明。
